recipes.title: Apples & Beef sirloin
steps: Pat the beef sirloin dry and season with herbs instead of salt.
Sear until cooked through, then rest for 5 minutes.
Sauté apples in a little oil until bright and tender.
Serve over cooked brown rice pasta.
recipes.clinicalFit: Built only from items approved for this clinical profile.

recipes.title: Asparagus grain bowl
steps: Cook brown rice pasta according to package directions, without added salt.
Toss asparagus with lemon, olive oil, and pepper.
recipes.clinicalFit: Low-sodium base with fibre-rich whole grains.

recipes.title: Sheet-pan bell peppers with beef sirloin
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss produce with oil, pepper, and smoked paprika.
Roast 20 minutes, adding the protein for the last 12 minutes.
Rest, then finish with a squeeze of citrus.
recipes.clinicalFit: No added salt; spices and citrus carry the flavour.
